posts.text:
The democratic establishment fears @stephenasmith. 

Why you may ask?

Because he can actually move the black American vote dems have owned since 1964.  

He’s to the democrats what Trump was to the Republican establishment.

He doesn’t need to move 50% of the black vote.  

20 million black Americans voted in the 2024 general election.  

If he moves 10%, it’s 2 million votes.  

Even 5% is a million votes.

That’s quite scary for the dems. 

Their strategy: 

1.  Undermine him 
2. Demonize him
posts.summary: Claims Stephen A. Smith could shift Black American voting patterns away from Democrats
